away.name: Dan Vladar

home.news: The Oilers have returned to relying on Devon Levi since his return from a lower-body injury, but the team hopes that Jarry can continue the success he had during that stretch. away.name: Sebastian Cossa

The Mammoth enter Wednesday's game as slight +109 road underdogs against a Vegas Golden Knights team with points in four straight games (3-0-1).

home.name: Carter Hart
home.news: The Golden Knights have had a liberal goalie rotation in recent weeks and will continue that trend on Wednesday, turning to Carter Hart. away.name: Sergei Murashov
away.news: The Penguins have struggled this season, and goaltending has rarely helped them, whether it's Arturs Silovs or Sergei Murashov. The Penguins enter Wednesday's contest as -137 road favourites against a San Jose Sharks team that has scored two or fewer goals in five of their last six games (1-5-0).

home.name: Yaroslav Askarov
home.news: Askarov has had an up-and-down 2026-27 season. The Sharks enter Monday's outing as +124 home underdogs against a Pittsburgh Penguins team coming off a 5-2 loss to the Anaheim Ducks.
